verdict.rationale: Figma Make's docs refer to a Make preview during the build loop: you can add annotations to it, mark it up with a draw tool, and copy snapshots of it as layers. Custom-domain support implies a separate publish step. The docs never explicitly say the preview is a live, clickable app you can interact with before publishing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the preview is interactive and running live, a description of what preview mode lets you do before publishing, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can interact with a live preview of my app while building, before publishing

citations.quote: Add [annotations](https://help.figma.com/hc/en-us/articles/42009840449175#h_01M30Q06FXE1CSX4XT91NBD0A4) to your Make preview to give the agent instructions for specific elements
Use the [draw tool](https://help.figma.com/hc/en-us/articles/42009840449175#h_01KFKBNVY9E1696HN77SJA3936) to mark up the preview and add those areas to your prompts
copy a snapshot of a preview as layers and then paste those layers into Figma Design
